label: s3-dispatch-cases-v1
status: SIMULATED public fixture (S3-01 phases 1-2, I-sim-dispatch-cases; phase 2 adds the persisted dispatch-3 result per case). Not field evidence. Fault-fixture labels are manifest annotations, not central attestation.

cases.label: Generator runs on a minigrid-roles-1 basis
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Indeterminate: missing roles pv_available_power, pcs_discharge_capability (never Candidate)

limitations: MISSING_ROLE: pv_available_power is not bound in the selected role set over 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000000Z..2026-10-02T00:00:00.000000Z; Candidate is unavailable there
MISSING_ROLE: pcs_discharge_capability is not bound in the selected role set over 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000000Z..2026-10-02T00:00:00.000000Z; Candidate is unavailable there

cases.label: Generator needed: near reserve and/or capability shortfall
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Necessary (BATTERY_NEAR_RESERVE / CAPABILITY_SHORTFALL) at the named instants

cases.label: Generator running while PV available + PCS discharge capability cover load x 1.1 and SOC > reserve + 10
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Candidate avoidable, bounded to the named segments (never the whole interval)

cases.label: PCS discharge-capability reporting gap (one hour) plus any UNAVAILABLE readings; no SUSPECT value is fabricated (Q2 default)
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Indeterminate across the gap: missing pcs_discharge_capability (never Candidate)

cases.label: One battery SOC publication held ten minutes (late at source publication only; not out-of-order, not centrally late - see late-central-acceptance). The ordinary path keeps source order within a source, so no reading is sequenced after a later one (Q5 ruling)
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Placed at its source time; delivered with its window, so it cannot by itself prove reassessment

cases.label: Two registered runs over one window on one gateway epoch
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Limited/Indeterminate: ambiguous cohort named (one epoch, two reports per channel-time); never summed, never separated by sequence range or receipt order

limitations: GENERATOR_SERIES_AMBIGUOUS: generator state reports are out of sequence order or overlapping; intervals cannot be reconstructed over those spans

cases.label: Two runs over one window on two gateway epochs
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Each epoch is its own cohort; an assessment selects one and names the other (no blending)

limitations: AMBIGUOUS_COHORT: a source reports the same time span under more than one sequence epoch (4895e665-0d07-4d7b-8f00-6aed7188f1a6@s3-cases-epoch-1, 4895e665-0d07-4d7b-8f00-6aed7188f1a6@s3-cases-epoch-2, de1bcf7b-e1d4-46a4-b805-964783550684@s3-cases-epoch-1, de1bcf7b-e1d4-46a4-b805-964783550684@s3-cases-epoch-2, ee1c9e5e-7f6b-4769-8b44-8991c29a9585@s3-cases-epoch-1, ee1c9e5e-7f6b-4769-8b44-8991c29a9585@s3-cases-epoch-2, f3535061-13b2-4ec3-87e3-437af2b969e0@s3-cases-epoch-1, f3535061-13b2-4ec3-87e3-437af2b969e0@s3-cases-epoch-2, f79339d6-a6a5-4241-a31e-6c64fab8dbb5@s3-cases-epoch-1, f79339d6-a6a5-4241-a31e-6c64fab8dbb5@s3-cases-epoch-2, fe8f8b1d-404a-41bf-b77e-a964ee33bde3@s3-cases-epoch-1, fe8f8b1d-404a-41bf-b77e-a964ee33bde3@s3-cases-epoch-2); no coherent default cohort; select one explicitly

cases.label: LABELLED FAULT FIXTURE: two different battery SOC values at one source time in one cohort (authenticated Batch V2, not gateway-sealed)
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Indeterminate: contradictory same-role samples (equal rank); never blended into source truth

limitations: NO_GENERATOR_STATE: no accepted generator state or output in the cohort

cases.label: LABELLED FAULT FIXTURE: a battery SOC at 05:15 centrally accepted BEFORE the same source's SOC at 05:00 (authenticated Batch V2, not gateway-sealed)
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Limited: SEQUENCE_ORDER_INVERTED over 05:00-05:15 names both IDs; never re-sorted by receipt

limitations: NO_GENERATOR_STATE: no accepted generator state or output in the cohort

cases.label: Ordinary registered run whose last sealed batches are HELD at the gateway until after a first central assessment (gateway order kept; Architect F3)
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: A new recompute job and new revision(s) at cutoff B; the cutoff-A revision stays addressable
